title: M30 Champion Multi-Market Robustness Test (USDJPY)
research_question: Does the M30 Fibonacci EA champion configuration (InpTP1Pips=15.0, InpDirection=2, InpMaxSLPips=15.0) generalize profitably to USDJPY without any parameter adjustments, maintaining positive net profit and max equity drawdown <= 8.0% across both 2020-2024 training and 2025 validation partitions?
hypothesis: Because the Fibonacci retracement and multi-timeframe trend alignment logic captures structural auction market physics rather than pair-specific curve-fitting, the champion configuration will execute profitably on USDJPY M30 with controlled drawdown <= 8.0%.

facts: EXP-0022 on GBPUSD M30 achieved Profit Factor 3.68 and 2.07% drawdown in training (2020-2024).
EXP-0023 on GBPUSD M30 achieved +$505.25 net profit, Profit Factor 1.49, and 3.88% drawdown in validation (2025).
EXP-0026 on EURUSD M30 achieved +$530.14 net profit and Profit Factor 1.84 in training (2020-2024).
EXP-0027 on EURUSD M30 achieved +$535.68 net profit and Profit Factor 1.62 in validation (2025).
EXP-0028 on AUDUSD M30 was non-robust in training (PF 0.04, DD 8.15%), though it recovered in validation EXP-0029 (+380.79, PF 1.19).
USDJPY provides an uncorrelated JPY macro dynamic driven by monetary divergence and strong clean trend expansions.
inferences: Testing the champion setup on USDJPY completes the 4-pair multi-market robustness matrix targeted in the research continuity plan.
USDJPY typically exhibits sharp directional trend runs, which may provide favorable conditions for the 15/30 pip partial close and trailing mechanism.

independent_variables.name: symbol
independent_variables.rationale: Evaluate champion M30 configuration across independent major currency instrument (USDJPY) to complete the 4-pair portfolio matrix.

assumptions: USDJPY M30 spread remains within 1.0-3.0 pips (10-30 points) during active trading hours.
Fibonacci swing structure operates symmetrically on USDJPY price action.
expected_observations: Total net profit is positive on USDJPY M30.
falsification_conditions: Total net profit <= 0.0 on training or validation partition.
